title: Magnetic Bead Immunoprecipitation with Western Blot Readout

source_steps.summary: Prepare the input fraction and antibody-conjugated beads.
Add clarified lysate and binding buffer to the beads.
Rotate the immunoprecipitation reaction at 4 C.
Separate and retain the captured beads while collecting flowthrough.
Wash the bead-bound target three times.
Denature, elute, and separate the target from spent beads.
Prepare input, flowthrough, and eluate samples.
Load assigned lanes and run electrophoresis.
Activate and equilibrate PVDF and transfer the separated proteins.
Block, probe, and wash the transferred membrane.
Acquire and return the structured Western blot readout.

semantic_boundaries.label: Western blot interpretation
semantic_boundaries.paper_wording: Band identity, enrichment, and imaging-quality interpretation remain downstream of the recorded signals.

avoid_claiming: Do not claim biological enrichment or band identity beyond the recorded readout fields.
